entities.name: Darigaaz's Caldera
entities.description: Volcanic lake on Shiv, formerly the prison of the primeval dragon Darigaaz.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Primeval red dragon, reborn from Gherridarigaaz, who woke the primevals.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Red Numena who entombed Rhammidarigaaz in the caldera.

entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: Shivan Dragon from whom Rhammidarigaaz was reborn.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out most of Shiv.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Figure who brought Darigaaz to the caldera.

entities.name: Dragon Nations
entities.description: Dragons who followed Darigaaz to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Place where Darigaaz led the Dragon Nations to wake Rith.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: First of the dormant Primevals, to be awakened.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: Era in which Rhammidarigaaz was entombed.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which Darigaaz was shown his tomb.

events.summary: Averru entombed Rhammidarigaaz in the caldera during the Fall of the Primevals.
events.quote: was entombed by the red Numena Averru in the caldera

events.summary: Rhammidarigaaz was reborn from the Shivan Dragon Gherridarigaaz.
events.quote: until Rhammidarigaaz was reborn in c. 3346 AR

events.summary: Tevesh Szat brought Darigaaz to the caldera and showed him his former tomb.
events.quote: Tevesh Szat brought Rhammidarigaaz to the caldera and showed him his former tomb

events.summary: Darigaaz took the Dragon Nations to Yavimaya to wake the first Primeval, Rith.
events.quote: took the Dragon Nations with him to Yavimaya to wake the first Primeval
